prompt.zh-TW: 藍鯨水族把向銀行借的短期借款一次還清，連同利息 {{money:e1.interest}} 一起付掉。這筆交易之後，下面四個數字各會怎麼變？
prompt.en: Blue Whale Aquatics repays its short-term bank loan in full and pays the interest of {{money:e1.interest}} at the same time. After this transaction, how does each of the four figures below change?

explanation.zh-TW: 一筆付款拆成兩類。還掉的本金 {{money:e1.principal}} 是還給資金提供者（銀行）的錢，讓{{term:tm_vk8v09cy}}減少。利息 {{money:e1.interest}} 是借錢的代價，課程模板把它列在營業活動的{{term:tm_y7a34vmk}}這一列（現行準則也允許列籌資，本課選營業；IFRS 18 適用後一般企業要改列籌資，詳見名詞卡），所以{{term:tm_e61ht6yh}}也減少。沒有買賣長期資產，投資活動不動；短期借款在資產負債表上歸零。
explanation.en: One payment splits into two kinds. The principal of {{money:e1.principal}} is repaid to a provider of funds, the bank, so {{term:tm_vk8v09cy}} falls. The interest of {{money:e1.interest}} is the price of borrowing, and the course template places it on the {{term:tm_y7a34vmk}} line under operating activities (the standard currently also allows financing and the course chooses operating; once IFRS 18 applies, most entities will have to use financing, as the term card explains), so {{term:tm_e61ht6yh}} falls as well. No long-term asset was bought or sold, so investing is untouched, and short-term borrowings on the balance sheet drop to nil.
